qa: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait, or a Tamer card with [Davis Motomiya] in its name is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait and 1 card with [Davis Motomiya] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and one of your other Digimon in play may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.
